# Skill Olympus

> Skill Olympus v6.0.0 is an open-source workflow system for AI coding runtimes. It integrates Claude Code, Codex CLI, Google Antigravity CLI, and Grok Build, and provides skills-only installation for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.

## Product model

- 100 public skill sources
- Default allowlist union: 24 entries
- User-facing entry points: 18
- Runtime adapters: 6
- Source-only internal or optional modules: 76
- Custom agents registered by default: 0

Claude exposes 21 active skills. Codex and Antigravity expose 20 each. Grok reads the shared Claude surface and sees the same 21 active entries. OpenClaw and Hermes Agent each receive 18 portable entry points plus the 76 source-only modules; Olympus does not claim plugin, hook, Mnemo, MCP, custom-agent, or runtime-adapter parity on those two hosts.

## Core workflow

Zeus is the delivery harness: parse the request, plan with Zephermine, implement with the current CLI's native workers, inspect with Argos, prepare a reproducible runtime with Docker, test with Minos, and produce an evidence-backed report. Chronos is the persistence rail across that flow. Mnemo is the memory rail across sessions.

## Installation

- Windows integrated runtimes: .\install.bat
- macOS/Linux integrated runtimes: chmod +x install.sh && ./install.sh
- OpenClaw: install-openclaw.bat or bash ./install-openclaw.sh
- Hermes Agent: install-hermes.bat or bash ./install-hermes.sh
